seoTitle: How to View Your Purchase History on eBay
metaDescription: Learn how to find and filter your past eBay orders in the My eBay Purchase History tab on both the website and mobile app.
intro: Knowing how to access your eBay purchase history makes it easier to track shipments, request returns, and reorder items you've bought before. This guide covers finding the Purchase History tab, filtering your orders, and locating archived or hidden purchases.

steps.heading: Go to My eBay
steps.body: Open the My eBay section on the website or app, which is the hub for managing your account activity.

steps.heading: Open the Purchase History tab
steps.body: From My eBay, select Purchase History to see a list of everything you've bought.

steps.heading: Filter by date, status, or item type
steps.body: Use the available filters to narrow down orders by date range, order status, or category.

steps.heading: Track shipments and manage returns
steps.body: From the same view, you can check delivery status, print invoices, request returns, or reorder frequently purchased items.

steps.heading: Check archived or hidden purchases
steps.body: If an order isn't showing, look in the archived or hidden section, since some purchases may have been moved there.

steps.heading: Review buyer protections
steps.body: Each order listed includes buyer protection details relevant to that purchase, which is useful to check before requesting a refund.

faq.question: Where do I find my purchase history on eBay?
faq.answer: You can find it in the My eBay section under the Purchase History tab, on both the website and mobile app.

faq.question: Can I filter my past orders?
faq.answer: Yes, you can filter purchase history by date, order status, or item type to find what you're looking for faster.

faq.question: What if a purchase doesn't show up in my history?
faq.answer: Check the archived or hidden purchases section, since older or hidden orders may not appear in the default view.

faq.question: Can I download receipts from my purchase history?
faq.answer: Yes, you can print or download invoices for past orders directly from your purchase history.

faq.question: Does purchase history work the same on mobile?
faq.answer: Yes, the same purchase history and filtering options are available in the eBay mobile app.
